advisories.summary: This tag is a no-op. It points at an existing commit and introduces no op-geth code changes.
Merges upstream go-ethereum v1.17.2. The default cache size is 4GB, and a debug_executionWitness bug that could corrupt node data is fixed.
advisories.action: Plan for the 4GB default cache. Upgrade if you call debug_executionWitness.

advisories.summary: Maintenance release with superchain registry updates.
Optimism does not support running op-geth from this release. It is a library release only, and op-geth is deprecated.
advisories.action: Do not run this release as a node.
